Existing deterministic startup-close/hash-close tests retain this opposite native-error/loss/unknown-origin contract using waitid(WNOWAIT), without fixture reaping. Both native delivery error cases passed full+3 repeats in both builds. This repairs fixture ordering rather than changing production semantics or accepting a weaker crash/outcome result. No selective retry of the historical failed command was used; it remains historical failed evidence.
